name: qtim
description: qtim feature specifications with stages, tickets and one explicit coordinator; independent review, Codex teams and missions.

interface.shortDescription: Feature stages, tickets and one coordinator
interface.longDescription: qtim feature planning: one specification with stages and tickets, independent review and owner approval. Explicit execution uses one original coordinator and a separate chat per ticket; workers return evidence for review and acceptance. Approval alone starts nothing. Legacy/spec-only sources, ordinary Codex teams and explicit missions retain their contracts.
